steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Xerxes invaded Greece in 480 BC with a massive army and fleet, aiming to conquer all of Greece | Key Fact: At Thermopylae, 300 Spartans under King Leonidas held the narrow pass for three days against the Persian army | Key Fact: The Greek position was betrayed when Ephialtes showed the Persians a mountain path to outflank the Greeks | Key Fact: Leonidas dismissed most troops but the 300 Spartans and 700 Thespians fought to the death — a symbol of heroic sacrifice

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from thermopylae &amp; salamis (480 bc), and one past-paper question.
